hook: Khosla co-founded Sun Microsystems in 1982 and served as its founding CEO before founding Khosla Ventures in 2004. In January 2019, Khosla Ventures led a 50 million dollar investment in OpenAI, becoming the first venture firm to invest in the company.
name: Vinod Khosla

primary.name: Khosla Ventures, Vinod Khosla team page

timeline.impact: Serves as founding CEO before Scott McNealy succeeds him
Focuses the firm on experimental and high-impact technology investments

timeline.event: Khosla Ventures leads a 50 million dollar investment in OpenAI
timeline.impact: Becomes the first venture firm to invest in OpenAI's for-profit entity

quick_facts: Founder of Khosla Ventures, established in 2004
Co-founder and founding CEO of Sun Microsystems in 1982
Khosla Ventures led a 50 million dollar investment in OpenAI in January 2019, its first venture firm investment
Held a stake described as approximately 5 percent of OpenAI's for-profit entity following the 2019 investment

achievements.title: Founder, Khosla Ventures
achievements.impact: Founded the venture capital firm in 2004 to invest in experimental technologies with broad societal reach.

achievements.title: Co-founder and founding CEO, Sun Microsystems
achievements.impact: Co-founded the company in 1982 with Andy Bechtolsheim and Scott McNealy, later joined by Bill Joy, and led it as founding CEO.

achievements.title: First venture investor in OpenAI
achievements.impact: Led a 50 million dollar investment in OpenAI in January 2019 through Khosla Ventures, its first outside venture backing.
